jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing
jobs.description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

The Head of Product Marketing will own the end-to-end strategy, operating model, performance bar, and talent development for the Product Marketing function at Plaid.

 

This leader will:

Set the PMM Strategy & Operating Model

 - Own and operationalize the PMM structure (Product Areas and Industry)  ￼

 - Finalize and institutionalize the PMM operating model￼

 - Define clear “PMM does / PMM does not” guardrails

 - Clarify cross-functional engagement norms with Product, GTM, Marketing, Comms

 - Establish KPI frameworks that tie PMM work to measurable business impact

 

 Elevate Quality & Narrative Coherence

 - Own Plaid’s central product narrative￼

 - Raise the messaging and positioning bar across all products

 - Ensure consistent product naming, positioning discipline, and storytelling rigor 

 

Drive Business Impact

 - Partner with Product on product-market fit strategy￼

 - Partner with GTM leadership to increase:
   
   - Quota attainment
   
   - Time to close
   
   - Campaign lift for priority industries  ￼

 - Ensure launch discipline, release alignment, and post-launch optimization




Build and Develop a Championship PMM Team

 - Directly manage senior PMM leads

 - Reset expectations where unclear scope exists

 - Upgrade performance management and leveling rigor ￼

 - Coach senior ICs and managers toward executive-grade PMM craft

 - Recruit and calibrate top-tier PMM talent




Serve as Executive Interface

 - Act as senior thought partner to: CMO, CEO/CPO, COO and Sales Leadership

 - Represent PMM in executive decision-making forums

 

Requirements

 - Minimum 10 years of experience in product marketing leadership at high growth B2B SaaS companies.

 - Experience managing large, multi-layered teams (15+)

 - Proven success as a Product Marketing leader at a B2B SaaS company of similar scale

 - Has built and led a team of world-class product marketers 

 - Success in a multi-dimensional phase of marketing maturity: multi-product / solution, multi-segment, multi-buyer

 - Is a builder - has been successful as a leader in a start-up / small company experience 

 - Low ego, high EQ

"Nice to Have" Experience

 - Domain experience: payments, credit, fintech, bank start-up

 - Experience working with / selling into financial institutions / banks

 - Experience marketing in a regulated environment

 - Experience in founder-led environments

 - Experience with PMM ‘rebrands’

The Financial Management team develops market leading API products that power the most influential digital finance experiences that help millions of consumers and small businesses every day - think budgeting apps and financial management tools offered by banks and wealth platforms. Our mission is to unlock financial freedom for everyone by making it easier for customers and businesses to meet their financial goals. We do this through a state-of-the art, data aggregation and machine learning engine that enables our customers to seamlessly build delightful experiences on top of consumer-permissioned financial data.

Every day, Plaid helps thousands of developers build a better financial future. You'll be responsible for defining the products which enable Plaid and our customers to shape the future of financial services.

We are looking for the right product manager to own and grow Plaid’s financial management products, including Transactions, Investments, and Liabilities, even more valuable to our customers and partners.

Plaid is on a journey to build insights on top of open banking data that drive value for customers, consumers and the fintech ecosystem in general. Additionally AI is changing how consumers use PFM tools. You’ll work closely with customers to identify opportunities in our Financial Management products, size them, and then work with engineering to bring them to life.

Product Managers at Plaid own the end-to-end problem that they are trying to solve with their team. You will set the product direction, drive new capabilities into our core offering and you will ensure sound strategic direction and effective detailed plans are in place from architecture to operations to go-to-market.

The ideal candidate has led technical, API-based B2B products, has an extreme attention to detail, concisely communicates complex concepts, and is able to operate independently and make bold, informed decisions without waiting for perfect information.

Responsibilities:

 - Discovering new problems and applications for Financial Management products. Our products are used across numerous, constantly evolving customer segments and use cases – you’ll have the opportunity to build on the leading edge of data products.

 - Collaborate with Engineering and Design to ship intuitive, high-quality experiences that drive enterprise value

 - Balance qualitative feedback & intuition with quantitative success metrics to drive high-quality decisions. Own and report on success metrics like product adoption and ARR

 - Delivering value at scale. Our products reach thousands of customers and millions of consumers, so you’ll have the opportunity to create widespread positive impact.

 - Long-term strategy and vision setting. You’ll define the path forward for your product area, and inspire stakeholders to help execute on your vision.

 - Collaboration and teamwork. You’ll work across a highly cross-functional team of engineering, data science, product marketing, and more to collectively deliver meaningful solutions.

 - Be the face of your product both internally and externally

Qualifications:

 - 4+ years of product management experience in a B2B context

 - Prior experience influencing pricing & packaging for their products

 - Experience directly participating in sales and account management conversations

 - Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering & Design

 - Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal; able to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences

 - Data-driven decision-making mindset; comfortable using both qualitative feedback and quantitative metrics to prioritize work.

The Customer Growth & Experience (CGX) team owns the full customer lifecycle - from the moment a customer lands on plaid.com http://plaid.com to their journey across onboarding, activation, adoption, and long-term success.



Within CGX, the Growth team owns Plaid's highest-leverage revenue levers. We optimize the self-serve funnel from a customer's first onboarding step through go-live and scale, build the upsell motion that expands existing customers, partner with GTM to remove friction from the sales flow, and own the premium enterprise features that unlock our largest customers. We operate data-first, using funnel analytics and experimentation to find and prioritize the bets that move the business.



As a Product Manager on the Growth team, you'll own one of Plaid's highest-leverage revenue surfaces: the self-serve funnel that takes customers from their first onboarding step through go-live and scale. You'll work to increase acquisition, reduce friction, and improve revenue efficiency across the SMB and long-tail base.



You'll partner closely with the Web team, Engineering, Design, BI/DS, Marketing, and Sales to build the upsell motion that expands existing customers, whether served in-product or routed to GTM as qualified opportunities, and to streamline the handoffs between self-serve and sales-assisted motions. You'll also help shape the enterprise features (e.g., SSO, audit logs) that unlock larger customers.


This role is ideal for a data-driven growth PM who's energized by moving the number quickly through experimentation while placing bigger strategic bets. It's an IC role with significant scope in an active investment area, with high visibility across GTM and Product leadership.



Responsibilities

 - Own and optimize the self-serve funnel end to end, from the onboarding flow through go-live and scaling

 - Drive scalable SMB and long-tail acquisition: grow new activated customers, reduce onboarding friction, and improve revenue efficiency

 - Build the upsell/cross-sell motion, surfacing intelligent recommendations self-serve or as qualified opportunities for GTM

 - Partner with GTM to understand the sales and account management flows, find where handoffs break down, and streamline for greater throughput

 - Use funnel analytics, segmentation, and experimentation to find, size, and prioritize the highest-leverage bets

 - Partner cross-functionally with Web, Engineering, Design, BI/DS, Marketing, and Sales to ship and measure impact
   
   

Qualifications

 - 5+ years of product management experience

 - Experience with product-led growth (PLG) at a B2B or API-first company, including top-of-funnel and activation funnels with quantifiable improvements

 - Strong analytical and funnel-optimization skills; comfortable making decisions from experiment and funnel data, and partnering closely with BI/DS

 - Track record partnering effectively with GTM teams (Sales, Partnerships, Marketing)

 - Experience building acquisition motions for SMB and/or supporting key accounts at scale

 - Excellent communication; can articulate tradeoffs clearly to GTM, Engineering, and cross-functional leadership



Nice to Have

 - Experience in fintech

jobs.description:

About Plaid & Our Mission Plaid's products empower thousands of developers to build the next generation of financial services applications. When developers need help, they rely on our teams to implement, support, and scale their solutions. Our mission is to support our customers quickly and compassionately, keeping their applications running smoothly and their end users happy. By making financial access seamless for developers, we help expand access to financial freedom for millions of people worldwide.

Team Dynamics & Your Impact Product Operations is an integral part of Customer Engineering and Support (CES). We translate CES leadership priorities into the tools, training, and processes their teams need to successfully support new products, features, and functionality. We partner with Product, Engineering, and Product Marketing to drive alignment before launch and provide continuous feedback to improve our products over time.

In this role, you will own a suite of Plaid products end-to-end as a trusted technical partner. You will have full ownership and independence to identify operational gaps, streamline product readiness, and ensure that our software engineering teams hear and act on critical customer feedback.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities & Impact)

 - Drive Product Launch Readiness: Identify documentation, tooling, and process gaps before new features launch, resolving issues proactive so customers experience smooth rollouts.

 - Empower Internal Teams: Build clear step-by-step guides, troubleshooting workflows, and training materials that enable customer-facing teams to operate independently.

 - Bridge Customer Insights to Product Strategy: Analyze frontline feedback using data to quantify customer pain points, representing these needs directly to Product Managers to shape the product roadmap.

 - Optimize Cross-Functional Workflows: Fix tooling and process bottlenecks across multiple departments to keep teams aligned and moving efficiently.

 - Lead Technical Strategy: Define end-to-end support strategies for assigned products, guiding them from early-stage testing through general availability.

Qualifications

What You Bring on Day One:

 - Technical Communication: Ability to write clear, structured documentation for both technical partners and senior decision-makers.

 - Data-Driven Analysis: Proficiency with SQL to pull, join, and analyze operational metrics independently to back up your recommendations with evidence.

 - Proven Track Record in Customer-Facing Technical Work: Experience in technical support, solutions engineering, implementation, or product enablement where you served as a trusted advisor.

 - Self-Directed Problem Solving: Comfort operating in ambiguous environments—identifying high-impact work independently rather than waiting for direction.

 - Influence Without Authority: Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and inspire change using data and clear reasoning.

What You Can Expect to Learn on the Job:

 - Domain expertise in specialized fintech areas such as credit, payments, and fraud prevention.

 - Advanced internal tool development and system customization.

 - Methodologies for designing and scaling formal Voice-of-Customer programs alongside Product Management.

Growth & Career Path In this role, you will build deep expertise across Plaid’s product line and operational architecture. As you scale your impact, career progression opens doors to Senior Product Operations Leadership, Technical Product Management, Strategic Customer Engineering, or Operations Management across the broader engineering organization.

The Customer Growth & Experience (CGX) team owns the full customer lifecycle — from the moment a customer lands on plaid.com http://plaid.com to their journey across onboarding, activation, adoption, and long-term success.



Within CGX, this role sits at the intersection of Growth and GTM. We own the product experience for sales-worked customers across every segment — onboarding, premium features, upsell and cross-sell, and offboarding — and the internal tooling that makes Plaid's own sales organization faster and more effective at every stage of a deal. We're focused on growing and retaining the accounts sales brings in, and on using AI to meaningfully change how sellers and their accounts get served, not just to speed up existing steps.



As a Product Manager on Sales-Assisted Growth, you'll own the experience for customers who come to Plaid through our sales team — SDRs, AEs, AMs from onboarding through expansion and offboarding: how they get set up, which premium features they unlock, how they discover and adopt new products, and how they're communicated with along the way.

You'll be expected to push hard on where AI can meaningfully change how accounts are grown and how sellers work, rather than just digitizing existing steps. You'll draw on propensity and account-health signals from our data science team, and help shape what those models should predict over time.



This is a high-impact IC role with a clear, ownable surface and plenty of room to shape how Plaid approaches customer growth. You’ll sit at the intersection of product and GTM, using account and pipeline insights to uncover expansion opportunities within the existing customer base and help identify where Plaid should invest next. 

It’s a unique opportunity to build across account growth, internal tooling, and AI-powered products; all within one role.

 - Own the sales-worked customer experience end to end — onboarding, premium and gated features, in-product upsell and cross-sell, lifecycle communications, and offboarding

 - Own external-facing tooling specific to sales-worked accounts (e.g., RFI response tooling, prospect-facing dashboards)

 - Partner cross-functionally with Eng, Design, BI/DS, GTM Technology, Lifecycle Marketing, and Sales and Account Management leadership to ship and measure impact



Qualifications

jobs.description:

Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About the Team
Our Network Enablement and Access team’s mission is to unlock the potential of the Plaid network by broadening and deepening our connection to data partners. We do this by providing solutions that allow our data partners to be part of the network and by providing best in class connections. By expanding and improving our connections to data providers, we are able to strengthen the Plaid network while also enabling great products and experiences.

Plaid's data access platform owns the deep-infrastructure layer that determines how reliably and efficiently data flows from our data providers to our customers. As the data supply network evolves, we are building the new platform capabilities that keep it strong: ensuring that our traffic stays smooth for the providers we depend on, building improved detection capabilities that enable us to catch issues as they happen, and evolving our data access toolkit to be more efficient over time.

About the role:

You will decide what data Plaid goes after next. Bank data got us here, but the picture our customers need now includes things we do not have: property tax, merchant and SKU-level purchases, utilities, tax, payroll. Some of it we should build with our own technology. Some of it we should partner or pay for. Someone has to make those calls with conviction and a real business case behind them, and that person is you.

This is a 0-1 role. You will start with two to three engineers and a mandate to prove something real: Plaid's first non-bank data offering, live, inside your first year. Along the way you will set the multi-year strategy for supply expansion, define what quality and completeness mean for data types nobody here has worked with before, and build the internal case that turns a promising vertical into a funded bet.

Responsibilities:

 - Set the multi-year strategy for non-bank data supply, grounded in what our products and customers need rather than what is technically interesting

 - Build and quickly execute against the one year plan - showcasing fast momentum and impact

 - Force-rank new data types across the company and own the business case for each, including the ones you recommend against

 - Make and defend build, buy, and partner decisions alongside data partnerships, corporate development, and legal

 - Ship Plaid's first non-bank data offerings, as internal insight inputs or externalized to customers

 - Partner with engineering and data teams on the taxonomies, quality controls, and coverage metrics that new data types require

 - Define the metrics for supply expansion and report progress to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders

Qualifications:

 - 8+ years of experience, including 5+ in product management or equivalent founder/operator roles.

 - Analytical rigor: You are comfortable working directly with data, cost models, and operational metrics to make and defend complex decisions.

 - Deep technical fluency: You can reason about large-scale systems, load management, API platforms, and machine-learning models and engage engineers as a close product partner.

 - Platform & systems thinking mindset: You think in systems, and design for reuse and the long term.

 - Leadership, stakeholder influence, and communication :You should be comfortable working cross-functionally (engineering, data, product) and influencing without direct authority. You must be able to explain complex technical ideas to non-technical stakeholders, drive alignment, and make trade-offs crystal clear

 - Establish and track the core traffic and cost metrics needed to operate the area, identify risks, and measure progress.
